dreamteamer.title: UI (React)
dreamteamer.description: The dreamteamer UI in React, over the same host contract as @dreamteamer/ui: the nav, collection lists and record pages, mounted by a host over a transport (postMessage in an editor, HTTP under dt web). Ships a library build, a browser page build and its source. A library: no collection, no verb.
